newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers gain $1, rest of Europe stable.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers gain $1, rest of Europe stable.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers gained $1 a tonne as the barge market edged up, while fuel oil prices in the rest of Europe barely changed, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was talked at around $87/$88 fob, a dollar higher than on Friday after the barge market edged up, one trading at $86 ex wharf.
Demand was very poor, ARA enquiries totalling less than 10,000 tonnes
"The numbers talked are those to sell at. Almost no-one's buying at all," one supplier said.
Hamburg fuel oil also rose by $1 and demand was similarly low.
Mediterranean fuel oil prices were steady, but gas oil weakened by $2/$3 in most ports.
